about: NVScript.osm builds this port knows how to recompile side by side (port/build.py and android/build_native.py --nvscript, repeatable).
A file given with --nvscript is identified by its sha256 here; that fixes its generated-code prefix and the guest address it is
lifted at, so several versions coexist in one build without symbol or address clashes. At run time the loader still picks
the version by the identity of the file on disk (size, ImageBase, entry point, code CRC: port/core/modules.c), never by label.
Labels are for people. The files themselves are not part of this repository: bring your own legally obtained copies.
